$comment: The source of sf-list-attention's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js), in the 1.4 form (scripts/generate-component-files.mjs writes rule.js, studio.fixture.json, studio.scenario.json, probe.json and smart.manifest.json from it). A new component, made against standard simai.smart-component 1.3.14 and vocabulary 1.1.5: the attention list the Larena admin screens asked for (Federation bus msg-993e1e39151942c19b23 item 2), planned in the reply msg-05e76ea0bc0746a690b8 as sf-list-attention of block list.

items.summary: The problems that need a person, each {id, status error|warning|info|success, title, text?, object?: {label, href?}, since?, source?, affected?, help?, dismissible?, action?: {label, href} or {label, event}}. object is what the problem is about (a link with href), since when it began (an ISO date-time or milliseconds; the row says how long it lasts), source the section or check it comes from, affected how many objects it touches (group mode's column), help a link about the check (the «⋯» menu), dismissible: false keeps «Не напоминать» off this item (the permission is the host's dismissible; an item can take it away, never give it). A property, or the JSON island a server prints; the host sets the whole list again when a problem appears or ends. The list orders them by severity (error, warning, info, success), inside a status the longest-lasting first where since is given, then the host's order. An item without an id or a title is left out; another status reads as info

label.summary: The heading; «Требует внимания» / «Needs attention» in the page language when not set. The summary badges, one per severity, stand beside it

heading-level.summary: The level of the heading in the page's outline

frame.summary: card (the default) draws the list as a surface card: a hairline edge, the surface radius, the head and the foot as bars of it; none is the bare list of 1.1, its rows on the page's text edge

triage.summary: Each problem gets a «⋯» menu: «Отложить на день», «Отложить на неделю» and, where the person may, «Не напоминать». A choice asks snooze {id, until} or dismiss {id}, then sets the problem aside with a notice whose «Вернуть» sends undo. A problem with help has the menu without triage too (only «Подробнее о проверке»)

dismissible.summary: This person may dismiss problems («Не напоминать», triage): the page's permission, and the only one that grants it; an item's dismissible: false takes it away from that item, its dismissible: true grants nothing

checked-at.summary: When the checks last ran (an ISO date-time or milliseconds): the foot says «Проверено 5 мин назад» / «в 14:05» / «9 ноября в 14:05» with a recheck button that sends recheck; the empty line says «Всё в порядке · проверено …»

limit.summary: At most this many rows; the rest are behind «Все проблемы (N)» (more-href) or «Показать все (N)» in place. 0 shows every row. Group mode shows every row

more-href.summary: The page of every problem: the foot's «Все проблемы (N)» is a link there, its press the cancelable request all {href}

group.summary: severity is the full checks page: a disclosure group per severity («Ошибки», «Предупреждения», «Рекомендации») open, «Пройдено» (passed) closed, an aligned column of affected counts; the time of the checks in the head

passed.summary: Group mode's «Пройдено»: the checks that passed, strings or {id?, title, text?}, a closed group after the problems

empty.summary: With no items: line (the default, owner decision C37) draws the head and one quiet line, empty-text with a check, «· проверено …» after it with checked-at, and a recheck button; none draws nothing at all (the host takes no room)

empty-text.summary: The quiet line of empty line; «Всё в порядке» / «All is well» when not set

size.summary: Deprecated until 2027-01-01 (change journal attribute-list-attention-size-to-density): the density comes from the page (data-sf-density, decision C22), never from a size. Until then size="1/2" still draws the list compact, noted in SF.deprecations and said once in the console (by SF.deprecations alone where the page opted in to its warnings); 1 is the normal density. Removing size="1": inside a compact region the list becomes compact; data-sf-density="normal" keeps it normal

navigate.summary: A person pressed a link of an item: its action's (part action), its object's (part object) or «Подробнее о проверке» in its «⋯» (part help) (vocabulary §5 navigate {id, href}). A request: a page cancels it to go there itself (a router); not cancelled, the browser follows href. A press with a modifier key or a middle button opens the link elsewhere and asks nothing

apply.summary: A person pressed an item's action button, one without href (vocabulary §5 apply {action, scope: entry, ids}): action is the item's action.event, ids the item's id. The host does it (restarts a job, opens a dialog) and sets the list again

snooze.summary: A person chose «Отложить на день» or «на неделю» in an item's «⋯»: until is the ISO instant one or seven days on. A request: cancelled, nothing changes; not cancelled, the item is set aside here at once and a notice says so with «Вернуть». The host stores the snooze and leaves the item out of the list until then

dismiss.summary: A person chose «Не напоминать» (only where the host's dismissible allows it). A request: cancelled, nothing changes; not cancelled, the item is set aside with a notice and «Вернуть»; the host stores it

undo.summary: A person pressed «Вернуть» on the notice of a snooze or a dismiss (action snooze | dismiss): the item is back in the list; the host forgets what it stored

recheck.summary: A person pressed «Проверить снова» (shown with checked-at). The host runs the checks and sets items and checked-at again

all.summary: A person pressed «Все проблемы (N)»: with more-href a link, the request first (a router cancels it); without it «Показать все (N)», and not cancelled, every row is shown in place

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.$comment: A section named by its heading; the problems are a list, each with its status said in words before its title (the filled icon is a picture), its action a native link or button and its «⋯» a button with aria-haspopup menu named «Ещё: <title>», opening sf-menu-context (arrows, Enter, Escape). A snooze or a dismiss moves the focus to the next row's «⋯» (else the previous one's, else the list) and the notice, a status message, holds «Вернуть»; undo brings the focus back to the row. Group mode's headers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. The empty line is a status. The list is no live region otherwise: a host that wants a new problem read out says so with its own announcement.

x-summary: The problems that need a person, in a card: a heading with a badge per severity, then each problem with a filled status icon, its title, what · how long · where, one quiet action and a «⋯» to snooze or dismiss it (undone from the notice), at most five and «Все проблемы (N)», when the checks ran and a recheck. With none, one quiet line «Всё в порядке · проверено …». group="severity" is the full checks page with a closed «Пройдено».

x-source.brief: Federation bus msg-993e1e39151942c19b23 item 2 from the Larena storage thread (owner-approved panel prototype, 2026-11-02): items {status, title, text, action: {label, href | event}}, ordered by severity, a heading with the count, with no items nothing at all or optionally one quiet line, never a big empty card. Used for server health, site checks, import and migration errors, update readiness, storage integrity, a form's validation summary.

x-decisions: name: sf-list-attention, a variant of block list (ui-control control/decisions/2026-11-02-smart-component-naming.md: sf-<block>-<variant>; the reply msg-05e76ea0). sf-list is the list a person acts on (selection, row menu, rename, paging) and its rows are entries to open; the attention list is a short summary of notices, each with one action of its own and no selection, so it is a variant with its own rows, not a setting of sf-list. It draws its parts with sf-icon, sf-badge and sf-button.

order: error, warning, info, success; the host's order inside a status (the list never sorts by anything else). An item without an id or a title is left out, a repeated id too; an unknown status reads as info.

count: the head shows a summary, one tonal sf-badge 1/3 per severity with its icon and plural words («2 ошибки», «3 предупреждения», «3 рекомендации»; info is neutral) -- not one number (owner decision C37); the most serious status is the host state data-status.

empty: empty line (the default since 1.2.0, owner decision C37) draws the head and one quiet line at the row's height H, a check of the success role, empty-text and «· проверено …» with checked-at, and a recheck; empty none draws nothing and the host takes no room.

action: {label, href} is a link (sf-button href, outline, scheme on-surface since 1.2.0: one quiet action, not the primary blue) and its press the cancelable request navigate {id, status, href} (vocabulary §5 navigate); {label, event} is a button and its press the fact apply {action: event, scope: entry, ids: [id], id, status} (§5 apply). An action without either is not drawn.

a11y: a section named by its heading (role region through aria-labelledby); the items a list; each item says its status in words before its title, visually hidden, so the icon is never the only sign. No live region: a host that wants a new problem read out announces it itself.

geometry (1.2.0, C18/C22/C37): one rung for the block, which the density moves a step: a row is --sf-ui-3--control-height H (56, 48 compact, 52 phone), its block inset what the title's line (text 1) and the meta line (text 1/2) leave of H, so a two-line row is H and a one-line row centres in H; the filled status icon is --sf-icon-size-3 (24/20) on the title's line; the action (sf-button 1/2 outline on-surface) and the «⋯» (sf-button-icon 1/2 ghost) are centred, their overhang taken back; gaps --sf-space-1/2; the card's inline inset --sf-space-1 at the text edge and --sf-space-1/4 at the end. The rows are one grid of five columns (icon, text, affected, action, «⋯»), each a subgrid, so the actions and the affected counts align. Below 30rem (40rem in group mode) the action goes under the text at its start, the «⋯» stays on the title's line, the foot stacks on the text edge.

css-variables: five public variables (§6) -- the fill (none by default), the dividers, the heading's colour, the inline inset and the gap under the heading -- listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json; the Framework never sets one.

version 1.0.1 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

version 1.1.0 background-color-names: the public variable --sf-list-attention-background-color (C16 naming: a variable that sets a colour ends in -color, as the other 53 do). The former name --sf-list-attention-background is still read under the new one until 2027-01-01 (change journal token-component-background-color-names, src/core/contracts/token-aliases.v1.json); nothing draws differently.
version 1.1.1: the size rule C18 (2026-11-09): the text's flex basis is the size step f0 (10rem, 160 px, as before), written as the token.

version 1.2.0 (2026-11-10, owner decision C37; research ui-control control/research/2026-11-09-list-attention.md, prototype prototypes/list-attention.html scenes А and Б): the summary badges, item fields object/since/source/affected/help/dismissible, the meta line, the quiet action, triage («⋯»: snooze a day / a week, «Не напоминать» only where the host's dismissible allows it and the item's dismissible is not false, help as a link whose press asks navigate part help) with snooze/dismiss requests and undo from an SF.notify notice, checked-at and recheck, limit 5 and more-href «Все проблемы (N)» (event all), frame card by default, empty line by default, group severity with passed, ordering by since inside a status, the rung on the ladder. size is deprecated until 2027-01-01 (journal attribute-list-attention-size-to-density): the density is the page's (C22); size="1/2" still draws compact until then. Changed defaults: frame card and empty line (a list that relied on none sets empty="none" frame="none"). Not taken: tinted banners (scene В), today's view.

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-10, a patch; R074 F3, DEV acceptance): every status glyph the list can draw -- error, warning, info and check_circle, filled for the rows and outlined for the head badges -- is declared to the Loader when the list connects, before it has items, through preloadControlIcons (smart/helpers/cycle.js, as sf-segmented and sf-tag); group mode's chevron and the «⋯» menu's icons are added when drawn. The status icons ride the page's first icon request instead of a second one. The list's own preload function is gone. Nothing draws differently.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-10, a patch; pair-next sweep): the template reads its computed values under keys of their own -- passedGroup (the closed «Пройдено» group, null without passed checks) and emptyLine (the empty line with the time of the checks) -- instead of under the settings passed and empty-text, whose getters hold the setting as given ([] and the default text). The template-context probe compares the two. Nothing draws differently.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: finding the problems (the host checks and sets the list)
deciding when a problem ends (the host sets the list again)
doing an action (the host answers apply or navigate)
storing a snooze or a dismiss (the host answers snooze, dismiss and undo)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-list-attention on an overview screen for the problems that need a person now: server health, site checks, import errors, update readiness, a form's validation summary.
do_not: Do not wrap it in a card of your own: frame card is its own frame; frame none for a list inside a card
Do not use it for news or a history; sf-list-feed or a timeline does that
Do not use it for a page-wide condition above the header; sf-alert-bar does that
Do not store snoozes in the page: the host stores what snooze and dismiss ask and leaves those items out
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-list-attention triage checked-at="2026-11-09T14:05:00+03:00" more-href="/checks/"><script type="application/json" data-sf-settings>{"items": [{"id": "cert", "status": "warning", "title": "Сертификат истекает через 6 дней", "object": {"label": "demo-static.test", "href": "/sites/demo-static/"}, "source": "Сертификаты", "action": {"label": "Продлить", "href": "/sites/demo-static/ssl/"}}]}</script></sf-list-attention>

keyboard: Tab reaches each item's object link, action and «⋯» in order, then the foot's recheck and «Все проблемы»; Enter follows a link, Enter or Space presses a button
In the «⋯» menu the arrows move, Enter chooses, Escape closes and gives the focus back
accessibility.focus: The list takes the focus only when the row that had it is set aside and no other row is left (tabindex -1 on the section).
